properties.COMMENTS: The Salish Sea Landforms polygons identify landforms along 2,200 miles of Salish Sea shoreline that have characteristics of deep-seated landslides, but lack the thorough investigation necessary to classify these landforms as landslides.
properties.SOURCE_INFORMATION: Washington State Department of Natural Resources, unpublished GIS data
